newsitem.title: MOROCCO: International potholers explore Moroccan caves.
newsitem.headline: International potholers explore Moroccan caves.

text.p: Potholers from five countries on Friday emerged from a deep complex of caves and underground lakes in southern Morocco after several days of exploration, a Moroccan official said.
"They have just come out. They have finished their mission, without any problems," said the official at the Wim-Timdouine complex some 70 km (45 miles) northeast of Agadir.
The speleologists comprised two from Ireland, two from France, one from Canada, two Lebanese and 24 Moroccans, he said.
Wim-Timdouine grotto is one of the deepest in North Africa, according to the Moroccan news agency MAP.
